title: Challenge Mission
wikitext:
[[Challenge Mission]]s are special repeatable [[mission]]s where a single player or a team of four to eight players (exact number is mission dependent) battle against either monsters or AI controlled players under special victory and failure conditions. Depending on a team's achievements in a mission, the team members are rewarded with various amounts of [[faction|faction points]], [[experience]], [[gold]], or [[armor]] pieces. Challenge mission ladders are maintained both by a [[records keeper]] [[NPC]] in the respective outposts for the area the missions take place. These ladders document daily, monthly, and quarterly scores.

==Available challenge missions==
===Core===
These missions take place on [[The Battle Isles]] and reward players with [[Balthazar faction]].
*[[Zaishen Challenge]]
*[[Zaishen Elite (mission)|Zaishen Elite]]

===Factions===
The challenge missions in Factions reward successful players with [[gold]] and [[experience]]. These missions also reward players with [[Kurzick faction]] in case of the missions in the [[Echovald Forest]], or [[Luxon faction]] in the missions on the [[The Jade Sea|Jade Sea]]. No faction is awarded in the [[Dragon's Throat]] mission, which takes place on neutral ground.
*[[Dragon's Throat]] ([[Kaineng City]])
*[[Altrumm Ruins]] ([[Echovald Forest]])
*[[Amatz Basin]] ([[Echovald Forest]])
*[[Zos Shivros Channel]] ([[The Jade Sea]])
*[[The Aurios Mines]] ([[The Jade Sea]])

===Nightfall===
These missions reward players with gold and experience, as well as armor pieces of a kind that depends on the mission.
*[[Dajkah Inlet]] ([[Kourna]]) for [[Stolen Sunspear Armor]]
*[[Remains of Sahlahja]] ([[The Desolation]]) for [[Ancient Armor Remnant]]s
*[[The Shadow Nexus]] ([[Realm of Torment]]) for [[Mysterious Armor Piece]]s

===Eye of the North===
This mission rewards players with armor pieces and a [[Destroyer Core]]. This mission also rewards all players with 25 [[Deldrimor rank|Deldrimor reputation points]] for each wave of [[Destroyer]]s defeated.
*[[Glint's Challenge]] ([[Central Transfer Chamber]]) for [[Cloth of the Brotherhood]]

===Festival===
This mission rewards players with [[Trick-or-Treat Bag]]s, [[gold]], and [[Gamer]] points depending on how quickly it is completed. 
*[[Scarred Psyche]] (during [[Halloween]])

==Notes==
* The ladders used to be available with an [http://www.guildwars.com/competitive/challenge_mission_ladder/default.php online ladder] on the Guild Wars website itself. It is no longer available.
